description: Content Security Policy configurations for different environments

development.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:* ws://localhost:*

staging.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'

production.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'

best_practices.explanation: These CSP policies follow Manifest V3 security best practices
rules: Never use 'unsafe-inline' for scripts in production
Restrict connect-src to necessary domains only
Set base-uri to 'self' to prevent frame injection
Set form-action to 'self' to prevent form hijacking
Use sandbox attribute for iframes containing untrusted content
